text: おぼえさせたい　わざが　あったら　キノコを　もってきてね！

structure.jp: おぼえさせたい　わざが　あったら
structure.en: if there is a move you want to have it learn

structure.jp: キノコを　もってきてね！

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる means making or letting someone else do the action, and たい on the end adds 'want to'. おぼえさせたい = 'want to make it learn'.

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら after a verb means 'if' or 'when that happens'. あったら = 'if there is'.

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: A て-form verb plus くる means doing it and coming here. The final て makes it a casual request. もってきて = 'bring it here'.
